title: Bulgaria – Engineering design services – „Изработване на Разширен идеен проект с извършване на пълни инженерно-геоложки проучвания за ново трасе по направлението „Свищов – АМ „Русе – Велико Търново“
description: Предмет на настоящата обществена поръчка е „Изработване на Разширен идеен проект с извършване на пълни инженерно-геоложки проучвания за ново трасе по направлението „Свищов – АМ “Русе-Велико Търново“. Целта на обществената поръчка е: - Да бъде определен изпълнител и да се сключи договор за изработване на Разширен идеен проект с пълни инженерно-геоложки проучвания за ново трасе по направлението „Свищов – АМ „Русе – Велико Търново“, в съответствие с нормативните изисквания и при спазване на договорените срокове; - Да се осигури проект за велосипедна алея по направление на трасето, като част от европейски велосипеден коридор - „Евро Вело 6“. 1. Кратко описание Развитието на транспортната достъпност от гр. Свищов до главните транспортни артерии – АМ „Хемус“ и АМ „Русе – Велико Търново“ е възможно чрез реализацията на ново трасе, свързващо гр. Свищов с трасето на АМ „Русе – Велико Търново“. Трасето представлява ключов елемент за развитието, както за националната, така и за европейската транспортна мрежа. Изграждането на велосипедна алея по протежение на новото трасе ще допринесе за разширяване на веломрежата на Община Свищов и на „Евро Вело 6“ на територията на България. Реализирането на проекта е пряко свързано с ферибот „Свищов – Зимнич” и Дунавски индустриален технологичен парк – Свищов, който се превръща в основен двигател на икономическия растеж и инвестиционната активност, както на общинско, така и на регионално ниво. Местоположение Новото трасе по направлението „Свищов – АМ „Русе – Велико Търново“ е разположено в Област Велико Търново и Област Русе, с приблизителна дължина около 25 км по Вариант 1 и около 33 км по Вариант 2. За Вариант 1: Началото на участъка се обвързва със съществуващата републиканска инфраструктура, разположена в източната част на гр. Свищов, а краят на участъка с трасето на АМ „Русе – Велико Търново“, посредством пътен възел около гр. Бяла. За Вариант 2: Началото на участъка се обвързва с републикански път II-52 при западния изход на гр. Свищов, а краят на участъка с трасето на АМ „Русе – Велико Търново“, посредством предвидения пътен възел между с. Страхилово и гр. Полски Тръмбеш. 2. Инвестиционен проект (Проектна документация) Инвестиционният проект (Проектната документация) следва да бъде изготвен в три проектни етапа в обем и съдържание, определени в Заданието за изработване на Разширен идеен проект (Приложение А), включващ: Част „Геодезия“; Част „Инженерно-геоложки и хидрогеоложки проучвания“; Част „Пътна“; Част „Транспортно експлоатационни разходи“; Част „Опазване на околната среда“; Част „Опазване на културното наследство“; Част „Организация и безопасност на движението“; Част „Конструктивна“; Част „Сеизмичност“ Част „Засегнати съоръжения и комуникации, собственост на други ведомства“; Част „Осветление на пътни възли“; Част „Интелигентни транспортни системи“; Част „Снегонавяване и снегозащитни съоръжения“; Част „Ландшафтно оформяне на пътя“; Част „Териториална обезпеченост“; Част „Съгласувателна документация” - съгласуване на проекта със заинтересованите ведомства, експлоатационни дружества на засегнатите от проекта съоръжения, собственост на други ведомства и дружества, както и административни структури, свързани с приложимите технически нормативни документи и действащата нормативна уредба в рамките на изпълнение на обществената поръчка. *Забележка: Проектната документация за пътните участъци във фаза „Идеен проект” (Разширен), следва да бъде разработена в необходимия обем и съдържание, и да отговаря на изискванията, посочени в Раздел ІІ, Глава осма от ЗУТ за инвестиционно проектиране и разрешаване на строителство, Наредба № РД-02-20-2 от 28.08.2018 г. за проектиране на пътища и Наредба № 4 от 21 май 2001 г. за обхвата и съдържанието на инвестиционните проекти. 3. Предметът на обществената поръчка включва описание на дейностите по поръчката, съгласно Изискванията към изпълнението (Приложение № 1), приложени към документацията за обществената поръчка.

Размерът на съответните стоки ще се конкретизира чрез подаване на заявка от Възложителя или определени от него лица. В срок до 10 календарни дни считано от датата на влизането в сила на договора Изпълнителят предоставя информация за размерите на спасителните костюми за работа във вода, включващи диапазона най-малко от 165 cm до 195 cm, обезопасяващите обувки съответно най-малко от номер 36 до номер 47 по Европейската номерация (EU) и на предпазните ръкавици с размер не по-малко от S до XL включително. Срокът за изпълнение на доставките е до 120 календарни дни, считано от получаване на заявката на Възложителя от Изпълнителя, но не по-късно от 11.02.2028 г. Заявката се изпраща от Възложителя или определени от него лица в срок до 30 календарни дни считано от датата на влизането на договора в сила. Договорът може да се изменя по отношение на срока за изпълнение на обществената поръчка (11.02.2028 г.), на основание чл. 116, ал. 1, т. 1 от ЗОП, по взаимно съгласие на Страните, изразено в писмена форма, в случай, че с допълнително споразумение бъде изменен срокът за изпълнение на дейността/проекта, уговорен с договор за финансиране № 18437/12.03.2025 г., за изпълнение на стратегически проект Floodguard 2 „Повишаване на капацитета за превенция и реагиране в случай на наводнения и последващи бедствия и извънредни ситуации в трансграничния регион“, финансиран по програма Interreg VI-A Гърция-България 2021-2027 г. Срокът за изпълнение на съответната дейност се удължава с период, съответстващ на периода, с който е удължен срокът по дейността/проекта, но не повече от периода между датата на изтичане на срока за изпълнение на съответната дейност и крайната дата на удължения срок по дейността/проекта. Обхватът и естеството на възможното изменение, както и условията, при които то може да се използва, не трябва да води до промяна в предмета на поръчката. Изменението следва да съответства на измененията в правилата и указанията на финансиращия орган и/или в договора за предоставяне на БФП, които единствено могат да бъдат фактическо основание за изменението на Договора в хипотезата на чл. 116, ал. 1, т. 1 от ЗОП.

description: Предмет на настоящата обществена поръчка е извършването на услуга във връзка със зимното поддържане (отстраняване на материали и други предмети в обхвата на пътя и премахване на храсти в обхвата на пътя), снегопочистване и опесъчаване на общинската пътна мрежа на територията на община Крумовград. В предмета на поръчката за всяка обособена позиция поотделно е предвидено да се извършва зимно поддържане, което включва дейностите по снегопочистване и обезопасяване на пътищата срещу хлъзгане, както и дейностите по отстраняване на материали и други предмети в обхвата на пътя и премахване на храсти в обхвата на пътя. Дейностите по снегопочистване и обезопасяване на пътищата срещу хлъзгане се извършват по цялата обща дължина на пътищата от общинската пътна мрежа по съответната обособена позиция. Дейностите по отстраняване на материали и други предмети в обхвата на пътя и по премахването на храсти в обхвата на пътя се изпълняват при възникнала необходимост след изрично възлагане от комисия назначена от възложителя. Изпълнителят на поръчката по съответната обособена позиция извършва: - денонощно дежурство на хора и техника през зимния сезон; събиране и предаване на информация за състоянието на пътната мрежа през зимния сезон; - снегопочистване: при снежна покривка над 5 см, при снегонавяване, при уплътнен снежен пласт и при снежна каша; - обезопасяване на пътищата срещу хлъзгане: обработка на пътната настилка чрез опесъчаване при наличие на леден пласт, поледица, скреж или заледяване; - отстраняване на материали и други предмети в обхвата на пътя и премахване на храсти в обхвата на пътя – след изрично възлагане от страна на възложителя се отстраняват онези материали и други предмети в обхвата на пътя, както и се премахват тези храсти в обхвата на пътя, които водят до образуване на снегонавявания. Обхватът, обемът и изискванията към изпълнението на обществената поръчка са подробно описани и регламентирани в Техническата спецификация, неразделна част от настоящата документация. Предоставянето на услугата, предмет на обществената поръчка е разпределено в шест обособени позиции, както следва: № 1 „Зимно поддържане и снегопочистване за сезон 2026-2027 г. на общинските пътища на територията на Община Крумовград, в участък „Вранско – Бараци - Ковил – Качулка – Джанка - Хисар”. title: Health Insurance for Locally Employed Staff
description: The Embassy of the United States of America invites you to submit a proposal for locally employed staff health insurance coverage. The Embassy encourages prospective offerors to offer off-the-shelf plans that meet at least the minimum benefit levels required in this solicitation. The U.S. Government intends to award a contract to the responsible company submitting an acceptable offer at the lowest price. We intend to award a contract based on initial proposals, without holding discussions, although we may hold discussions with companies in the competitive range if there is a need to do so. The Embassy intends to conduct a pre-proposal conference. The pre-proposal conference will be held on October 28, 2026 at 10 a.m. at the U.S. Embassy Kuala Lumpur. Prospective offerors should contact the Procurement Supervisor; Punitha Ratnasingam at ratnasingamp@state.gov by October 23, 2026 before 12 p.m. for additional information or to arrange entry to the building. Proposals are due on November 16, 2026 before 12 p.m. No proposals will be accepted after this time. Proposals must be in English and incomplete proposals will not be accepted. Your proposal must be submitted electronically to KualaLumpurDTO@state.gov .It is important to make sure the submission is made in specific size and format; in MS-Word 2007/2010 or MS-Excel 2007/2010 or Adobe Acrobat (pdf) file format. The file size must not exceed 30MB. If the file size should exceed the 30MB, the submission must be made in separate files and attached to separate emails with less than 30MB each. In order for a quotation to be considered, you must also complete and submit the following: 1. SF-1449 2. Section B, Pricing Schedule. 3. Section B, Retention Amounts in B.3 4. Section K, Representations and Certifications; and 5. Additional information as required in Section L. 6. Proof of SAM Registration Offerors shall be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) database at https://www.sam.gov prior to submittal of their offer/proposal as prescribed under FAR 4.1102. Failure to be registered at time of proposal submission may deem the offeror�s proposal to be considered non-responsible and no further consideration will be given. Therefore, offerors are highly encouraged to register immediately if they are interested in submitting a response to this requirement.

title: Worldwide Professional Brokerage Services Synopsis
description: Department of State Overseas Buildings Operations Planning and Real Estate Worldwide Professional Brokerage Services Synopsis The Department of State plans to award multiple Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts for a two-year base and eight subsequent one-year options, at the discretion of the Government. The IDIQ awards will be made to the responsive Offerors whose proposal conforms to the solicitation and offers the �Best Value� to the Government, whereas technical considerations are more important than cost. This award will not be set aside for small business. Multiple awards will be made with each awardee being guaranteed a minimum of $25,000 for the entire contract period of performance and shall not be considered the minimum amount for each year should any option years be exercised. The overall ceiling price for the multiple award IDIQ contract is $35,000,000. The maximum aggregate dollar value of all task orders awarded under the IDIQ type contracts during the base year and option years exercised cannot exceed this ceiling. This ceiling is not being subdivided equally amongst the number of awardees, nor is it being multiplied by the number of awardees. The NAICS code for this requirement is 531210. The contractor shall provide real estate services for a variety of projects in every country throughout the world where DOS has a presence (over 290 U.S. diplomatic posts worldwide). The DOS� real estate portfolio includes land (improved and unimproved), office buildings, office space, warehouses, recreation areas/centers, representational facilities, residential properties (single, multi-family and apartment buildings), motor vehicle facilities, support facilities, and mixed-use properties that support its diplomatic missions overseas. Services include, but are not limited to, the preparation of oral reports narrative reports, form advisory reports concluding to an estimate or range of price and highest net value to the United States Government, rent studies, reports on real estate/development trends, feasibility studies, property searches, sales brokerage and marketing services, highest and best use studies, appraisal support assistance, broker opinion of value, Architect and Engineering services, real estate disposal services, available ownership interest reports, tenant representation/leasing services, buyer representation services, field work, real estate legal counsel services, geospatial analytics, planning/zoning/entitlements, public-private partnership analytics, and other real estate consulting services as needed. Proposal Submissions: The Request for Proposals and its attached documents will be posted under Solicitation Number, 19AQMM27R0034 on or around November 16, 2026. No paper copies will be mailed. Proposal submissions will be due no later than 5:00 PM, EST on December 21, 2026. The scope of services is similar to previous IDIQ solicitations and therefore the government does not anticipate any major questions or concerns from prospective vendors. Point of contact for this synopsis is Alaina Wooten who can be reached via email at WootenAN@fan.gov .

buyer: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF
title: NIH Scientific & Technical Expertise & Acquisition Management (STEAM)
description: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE NIH SCIENTIFIC & TECHNICAL EXPERTISE ACQUISITION & MANAGEMENT (STEAM) Sources Sought Reference Number: 75N98027R00012 Proposed NAICS Code and Size Standard: 541990 � All Other Professional, Scientific and Technical Services; $19.5 million in average annual receipts Sources Sought Notice Information Introduction This is a Small Business Sources Sought notice. This is NOT a solicitation for proposals, proposal abstracts, or quotations. The purpose of this notice is to obtain information regarding: (1) the availability and capability of qualified small business sources; (2) their small business and applicable socioeconomic status, including HUBZone, service-disabled veteran-owned, veteran-owned, 8(a), woman-owned, and small disadvantaged business status; and (3) their size classification relative to the proposed North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code. Responses will assist the Government in determining the appropriate acquisition method, including whether a full or partial small business set-aside is appropriate. Interested small businesses may respond for Task Area A (Professional Services), Task Area B (Highly Specialized Scientific Services), or both. Respondents should identify their ability to perform as a prime contractor, joint venture, or subcontracting team, distinguish their own capability from that of team members, and identify limitations within each task area addressed. NIH will assess capability separately for each area. Capability in both areas is not required to respond. The Government has not made a final set-aside determination. Background The National Institutes of Health (NIH) conducts and supports biomedical and behavioral research to advance scientific knowledge and improve health. NIH requires professional, scientific, and technical contractor support for current and emerging research priorities, ongoing research activities, and related program operations. Changes in research programs and scientific methods create a continuing need for flexible service delivery and specialized expertise. Scientific & Technical Expertise Acquisition & Management (STEAM) will acquire contractor-provided services and expertise to accomplish varied project-based requirements across NIH. Individual task orders will define project objectives, tasks, deliverables or milestones, performance periods, required expertise, and resource needs. Contractors must furnish and manage the resources needed to perform multiple concurrent projects at substantial volume and adjust those resources as authorized project requirements change. NIH anticipates using cost-reimbursement contracting approximately 20 percent of the time. The actual mix will depend on individual requirements. Firms should describe their experience and ability to support this component, including any preparation needed. Existing cost-reimbursement capability or a prior Government accounting-system approval is not a mandatory condition of responding to this notice. Applicable requirements, including accounting-system adequacy, would need to be satisfied before award of a cost-reimbursement order. Purpose and Objectives The purpose of STEAM is to provide professional, scientific, and technical support for NIH research and related activities. Support includes basic, translational, and clinical research; vaccine research; general and specialized laboratory research; veterinary and animal research support; bioinformatics; computational biology; and related professional and technical services. The contractor will furnish and manage qualified resources to accomplish each statement of work (SOW), including responsibility for recruiting, verifying qualifications, retaining its personnel, and maintaining continuity of performance. Services will be furnished under individual funded, project-based task orders. The contractor will furnish resources, including personnel with expertise corresponding to the applicable labor categories, to accomplish the SOW and deliver the required project outcomes and milestones. The contractor will retain responsibility for employing, supervising, and managing its personnel. Services will not include inherently governmental functions or unauthorized personal services. Each task order will identify the applicable task area, project scope, qualifications, location, performance schedule, and security and safety requirements. Project Requirements Services may involve expertise in microbiology, molecular biology, biochemistry, infectious diseases, immunology, clinical research, bioinformatics, genomic sequencing, proteomics, image analysis, computational and systems biology, and scientific data analysis. Related requirements may include clinical trials support, laboratory operations, veterinary services, program management, and other professional or technical support within the authorized scope. Qualifications range from positions without a degree requirement to licensed practitioners and highly specialized doctoral-level professionals. The contractor must be able to furnish qualified resources within the task area or areas addressed and manage a substantial volume of concurrent project requirements. Primary anticipated locations include Bethesda and Rockville, Maryland; other locations in the Washington, DC metropolitan area; and Hamilton, Montana. Other domestic locations, overseas support, travel, or remote work may be authorized by individual orders. NIH-wide demand for task orders and contractor support fluctuates across projects, locations, and time. This notice does not provide a fixed annual volume estimate or guarantee a minimum workload. Routine task orders will establish mobilization, onboarding, and performance start schedules. Under certain circumstances, an urgent or unforeseen NIH need may require the contractor to begin authorized performance within 48 hours. For an expedited request, NIH will identify the applicable timeframe and the event from which it is measured. Respondents should describe their ability to accommodate these requests, identify the categories and locations they could support, and explain any limitations or prerequisites. Contractors must ensure that their personnel have the qualifications and relevant experience required for the assigned work and complete applicable training, competency verification, occupational health requirements, and facility-specific access approvals before beginning restricted work. For assignments involving regulated select agents or toxins, applicable individual access approvals, security risk assessments, and required training must be completed before access. Prior experience at another laboratory does not establish authorization at the receiving NIH facility. An expedited task-order request does not waive these prerequisites. The following 156 labor-category families are organized into two task areas. Each family appears once. Categories encompass applicable levels and specialties; task orders will specify required duties and qualifications. Numbered levels are not automatically equivalent to Junior, Mid-Level, or Senior designations. The task-area structure supports market research and does not establish the final award structure. Task Area A � Professional Services This area covers general professional, management, administrative, business, IT, and technical support for NIH projects, including project coordination, financial analysis, enterprise systems, and related operational services. Scientific versions of otherwise general roles are assigned to Task Area B. Accessibility Specialist Accounting Technician Administration Administrative Support Administrative Support Assistant (Administrative Support) Advisor Agile Consultant Analytics Specialist BMC Administrator BMC Remedy Administrator Budget Analyst Business Process Consultant Business Systems Analyst Communications Specialist Computer Systems Analyst Consultant (Professional) Data Analyst Data Architect Database Administ

Existing cost-reimbursement capability or a prior Government accounting-system approval is not a mandatory condition of responding to this notice. Applicable requirements, including accounting-system adequacy, would need to be satisfied before award of a cost-reimbursement order. Purpose and Objectives The purpose of STEAM is to provide professional, scientific, and technical support for NIH research and related activities. Support includes basic, translational, and clinical research; vaccine research; general and specialized laboratory research; veterinary and animal research support; bioinformatics; computational biology; and related professional and technical services. The contractor will furnish and manage qualified resources to accomplish each statement of work (SOW), including responsibility for recruiting, verifying qualifications, retaining its personnel, and maintaining continuity of performance. Services will be furnished under individual funded, project-based task orders. The contractor will furnish resources, including personnel with expertise corresponding to the applicable labor categories, to accomplish the SOW and deliver the required project outcomes and milestones. The contractor will retain responsibility for employing, supervising, and managing its personnel. Services will not include inherently governmental functions or unauthorized personal services. Each task order will identify the applicable task area, project scope, qualifications, location, performance schedule, and security and safety requirements. Project Requirements Services may involve expertise in microbiology, molecular biology, biochemistry, infectious diseases, immunology, clinical research, bioinformatics, genomic sequencing, proteomics, image analysis, computational and systems biology, and scientific data analysis. Related requirements may include clinical trials support, laboratory operations, veterinary services, program management, and other professional or technical support within the authorized scope. Qualifications range from positions without a degree requirement to licensed practitioners and highly specialized doctoral-level professionals. The contractor must be able to furnish qualified resources within the task area or areas addressed and manage a substantial volume of concurrent project requirements. Primary anticipated locations include Bethesda and Rockville, Maryland; other locations in the Washington, DC metropolitan area; and Hamilton, Montana. Other domestic locations, overseas support, travel, or remote work may be authorized by individual orders. NIH-wide demand for task orders and contractor support fluctuates across projects, locations, and time. This notice does not provide a fixed annual volume estimate or guarantee a minimum workload. Routine task orders will establish mobilization, onboarding, and performance start schedules. Under certain circumstances, an urgent or unforeseen NIH need may require the contractor to begin authorized performance within 48 hours. For an expedited request, NIH will identify the applicable timeframe and the event from which it is measured. Respondents should describe their ability to accommodate these requests, identify the categories and locations they could support, and explain any limitations or prerequisites. Contractors must ensure that their personnel have the qualifications and relevant experience required for the assigned work and complete applicable training, competency verification, occupational health requirements, and facility-specific access approvals before beginning restricted work. For assignments involving regulated select agents or toxins, applicable individual access approvals, security risk assessments, and required training must be completed before access. Prior experience at another laboratory does not establish authorization at the receiving NIH facility. An expedited task-order request does not waive these prerequisites. The following 156 labor-category families are organized into two task areas. Each family appears once. Categories encompass applicable levels and specialties; task orders will specify required duties and qualifications. Numbered levels are not automatically equivalent to Junior, Mid-Level, or Senior designations. The task-area structure supports market research and does not establish the final award structure. Task Area A � Professional Services This area covers general professional, management, administrative, business, IT, and technical support for NIH projects, including project coordination, financial analysis, enterprise systems, and related operational services. Scientific versions of otherwise general roles are assigned to Task Area B. title: R706--486-27-2-3980-0006 - Wall-to-Wall Pharmacy Inventory
description: 1. Contractor experience and technical qualifications Question: May a newly established small business satisfy the minimum requirement of three years of wall-to-wall pharmacy inventory experience and experience at three pharmacies through the qualifications of proposed key personnel, subcontractors, or teaming partners? Will general retail, grocery, military inventory, or equipment-accountability experience qualify instead of pharmacy inventory experience? Government Response: No. 2. Historical inventory quantities, values, and workload Question: Can the Government provide historical inventory line-item counts, SKU quantities, replacement values, pharmacy sections, inventory areas, and prior inventory durations for each of the six facilities, separated by inpatient and outpatient pharmacies? Can the Government also provide historical staffing levels and facility square footage or shelving quantities? Government Response: Available historical inventory information will be provided in the attachment referenced by the Government. FY2026 inventory information is being compiled. Historical staffing levels are unknown, and facility square footage or shelving quantities are not available. 3. Physical inventory completion deadline Question: The solicitation contains references to both January 31 and February 28 for completing physical inventories. Which deadline governs? Government Response: All physical inventories at the six VA facilities shall be completed no later than January 31 of the applicable contract year. All final reports, validations, corrections, and required closeout documentation shall be completed and submitted no later than February 28 of that year. 4. Inventory scheduling and completion requirements Question: May the six facilities be inventoried sequentially by one crew, or must multiple facilities be inventoried concurrently? Are weekend or after-hours inventories permitted, and must each facility's inventory begin at 8:00 a.m. and be completed within one business day? Government Response: The six facilities may be inventoried sequentially between January 1 and January 31, provided that each facility's physical inventory is completed within one business day. Inventories shall ordinarily begin at 8:00 a.m. local time. Weekend work, after-hours access, and inventory dates must be coordinated with each individual VA Medical Center. One original response suggested concurrent scheduling, while several others expressly permitted sequential scheduling. This draft follows the repeated sequential-scheduling responses and should be confirmed. 5. Automated dispensing systems and controlled substances Question: Is the Contractor required to physically count medications contained in automated dispensing cabinets and packaging systems, or will the Government provide system-generated inventory reports? Who is responsible for counting controlled substances? Government Response: The VA Medical Center Pharmacy will generate inventory reports from applicable automated dispensing and packaging systems for incorporation into the Contractor's final reports. Controlled substances will be physically counted by authorized VA Pharmacy personnel, and the Contractor shall incorporate the Government-provided results into the final inventory reports. 6. Government-furnished data and pricing information Question: Will the Government provide product master files, McKesson Prime Vendor pricing information, direct-purchase costing information, and automated-system inventory extracts? What information must the Contractor obtain independently? Government Response: No. No, Vendor should get this from McKesson, Yes, Must meet the requirements of the SOW. 7. Final inventory report format and submission Question: What electronic format and data elements are required for final inventory reports? Will the Government provide a sample report template, and may reports be submitted after February 28 if the physical inventory was completed by January 31? Government Response: A separate electronic inventory report shall be submitted for each facility within seven calendar days after completion of its physical inventory. The report shall include facility, pharmacy/section, item name and strength, package description, applicable NDC/UPC/UPN, McKesson item number where applicable, quantity, current package price, extended replacement cost, section/location, and total inventory replacement cost. Reports shall be compatible with Microsoft Excel or an equivalent Government-approved spreadsheet application. The Government will not provide a sample report template. All final reports and required corrections must be completed by February 28. Reports submitted after that deadline will not meet the stated requirement. 8. Contractor equipment, software, and access Question: May the Contractor use its own handheld scanners and inventory software? Are specific scanning devices, software platforms, or VA network integrations required? What security and access requirements apply? Government Response: The Contractor may use its own scanners and inventory software, provided they meet the SOW requirements. 9. Pharmacy inventory scope and storage locations Question: Does outpatient inventory include satellite pharmacies and other pharmacy-controlled storage locations? Are medications stored in specialized or low-temperature refrigerators included? Government Response: The number and type of outpatient and satellite pharmacy locations vary by facility. All applicable medications under pharmacy control, including medications stored in specialized refrigeration units, shall be included unless specifically excluded by the SOW. The Contractor shall coordinate the inventory areas with each facility. 10. Incumbent contractor and historical contract information Question: Is this a new requirement or a recompete? If there is an incumbent contractor, what is the previous contract number, awarded contract value, and total price? Government Response: Professional Inventory Control Systems INC, 36C24926P0139, $19,200.00, $19,200.00. 11. Subcontractor participation and on-site staffing Question: May a small business prime contractor use a subcontractor to perform physical inventories under the prime's management and quality control? Must the prime contractor provide its own personnel on-site during each inventory? Government Response: No 12. Past performance evaluation Question: Will an offeror without directly relevant past performance receive a Neutral rating rather than an Unacceptable rating? Government Response: Neutral 13. Insurance and bonding Question: What insurance coverage and bonding requirements apply, including minimum limits, when evidence must be submitted, and whether a subcontractor's insurance may satisfy any part of the requirement? Government Response: Please reference the SOW. 14. Service Contract Labor Standards wage determination Question: The SOW references an applicable Department of Labor wage determination, but none is attached. Which wage determination applies to this requirement? Government Response: No Wage Determination applies. 15. Implementation plan submission Question: Is the implementation plan required with the technical quotation, or may it be submitted after contract award? Government Response: No 16. Solicitation status and amendments Question: Are the posted SOW and evaluation criteria final for quotation purposes, or does the Government anticipate issuing an amendment to clarify or revise the requirements? Government Response: Final.

title: R706--486-27-2-3980-0006 - Wall-to-Wall Pharmacy Inventory
description: Contractor answers to questions 1. Contractor experience and technical qualifications Question: May a newly established small business satisfy the minimum requirement of three years of wall-to-wall pharmacy inventory experience and experience at three pharmacies through the qualifications of proposed key personnel, subcontractors, or teaming partners? Will general retail, grocery, military inventory, or equipment-accountability experience qualify instead of pharmacy inventory experience? Government Response: No. 2. Historical inventory quantities, values, and workload Question: Can the Government provide historical inventory line-item counts, SKU quantities, replacement values, pharmacy sections, inventory areas, and prior inventory durations for each of the six facilities, separated by inpatient and outpatient pharmacies? Can the Government also provide historical staffing levels and facility square footage or shelving quantities? Government Response: Available historical inventory information will be provided in the attachment referenced by the Government. FY2026 inventory information is being compiled. Historical staffing levels are unknown, and facility square footage or shelving quantities are not available. 3. Physical inventory completion deadline Question: The solicitation contains references to both January 31 and February 28 for completing physical inventories. Which deadline governs? Government Response: All physical inventories at the six VA facilities shall be completed no later than January 31 of the applicable contract year. All final reports, validations, corrections, and required closeout documentation shall be completed and submitted no later than February 28 of that year. 4. Inventory scheduling and completion requirements Question: May the six facilities be inventoried sequentially by one crew, or must multiple facilities be inventoried concurrently? Are weekend or after-hours inventories permitted, and must each facility's inventory begin at 8:00 a.m. and be completed within one business day? Government Response: The six facilities may be inventoried sequentially between January 1 and January 31, provided that each facility's physical inventory is completed within one business day. Inventories shall ordinarily begin at 8:00 a.m. local time. Weekend work, after-hours access, and inventory dates must be coordinated with each individual VA Medical Center. One original response suggested concurrent scheduling, while several others expressly permitted sequential scheduling. This draft follows the repeated sequential-scheduling responses and should be confirmed. 5. Automated dispensing systems and controlled substances Question: Is the Contractor required to physically count medications contained in automated dispensing cabinets and packaging systems, or will the Government provide system-generated inventory reports? Who is responsible for counting controlled substances? Government Response: The VA Medical Center Pharmacy will generate inventory reports from applicable automated dispensing and packaging systems for incorporation into the Contractor's final reports. Controlled substances will be physically counted by authorized VA Pharmacy personnel, and the Contractor shall incorporate the Government-provided results into the final inventory reports. 6. Government-furnished data and pricing information Question: Will the Government provide product master files, McKesson Prime Vendor pricing information, direct-purchase costing information, and automated-system inventory extracts? What information must the Contractor obtain independently? Government Response: No. No, Vendor should get this from McKesson, Yes, Must meet the requirements of the SOW. 7. Final inventory report format and submission Question: What electronic format and data elements are required for final inventory reports? Will the Government provide a sample report template, and may reports be submitted after February 28 if the physical inventory was completed by January 31? Government Response: A separate electronic inventory report shall be submitted for each facility within seven calendar days after completion of its physical inventory. The report shall include facility, pharmacy/section, item name and strength, package description, applicable NDC/UPC/UPN, McKesson item number where applicable, quantity, current package price, extended replacement cost, section/location, and total inventory replacement cost. Please email mario.russell@va.gov for VISN 09 Spreadsheets. Reports shall be compatible with Microsoft Excel or an equivalent Government-approved spreadsheet application. The Government will not provide a sample report template. All final reports and required corrections must be completed by February 28. Reports submitted after that deadline will not meet the stated requirement. 8. Contractor equipment, software, and access Question: May the Contractor use its own handheld scanners and inventory software? Are specific scanning devices, software platforms, or VA network integrations required? What security and access requirements apply? Government Response: The Contractor may use its own scanners and inventory software, provided they meet the SOW requirements. 9. Pharmacy inventory scope and storage locations Question: Does outpatient inventory include satellite pharmacies and other pharmacy-controlled storage locations? Are medications stored in specialized or low-temperature refrigerators included? Government Response: The number and type of outpatient and satellite pharmacy locations vary by facility. All applicable medications under pharmacy control, including medications stored in specialized refrigeration units, shall be included unless specifically excluded by the SOW. The Contractor shall coordinate the inventory areas with each facility. 10. Incumbent contractor and historical contract information Question: Is this a new requirement or a recompete? If there is an incumbent contractor, what is the previous contract number, awarded contract value, and total price? Government Response: Professional Inventory Control Systems INC, 36C24926P0139, $19,200.00, $19,200.00. 11. Subcontractor participation and on-site staffing Question: May a small business prime contractor use a subcontractor to perform physical inventories under the prime's management and quality control? Must the prime contractor provide its own personnel on-site during each inventory? Government Response: No 12. Past performance evaluation Question: Will an offeror without directly relevant past performance receive a Neutral rating rather than an Unacceptable rating? Government Response: Neutral as this is based of LTPA. 13. Insurance and bonding Question: What insurance coverage and bonding requirements apply, including minimum limits, when evidence must be submitted, and whether a subcontractor's insurance may satisfy any part of the requirement? Government Response: Please reference the SOW. 14. Service Contract Labor Standards wage determination Question: The SOW references an applicable Department of Labor wage determination, but none is attached. Which wage determination applies to this requirement? Government Response: No Wage Determination applies. 15. Implementation plan submission Question: Is the implementation plan required with the technical quotation, or may it be submitted after contract award? Government Response: No. This is based off LTPA 16. Solicitation status and amendments Question: Are the posted SOW and evaluation criteria final for quotation purposes, or does the Government anticipate issuing an amendment to clarify or revise the requirements? Government Response: Final.

title: Recycling Services
description: (i)This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with RFO FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number W9124M-27-Q-A005 is issued as a RFQ for Recycling Services for Fort Stewart and Hunter Army Airfield, GA. This acquisition is set-aside for 100% 8(a) small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. (ii) See Solicitation SF 1449 for a list of line-item number(s) and items, quantities, and units of measure. (iii) This is a non-personal services contract to provide recycling services for the U.S. Army Garrison Fort Stewart (FS) and Hunter Army Airfield (HAAF), Georgia. The Contractor shall provide collection services for all recyclable materials from recycling containers at Fort Stewart (FS) AND Hunter Army Airfield (HAAF) and services to process and prepare material for resale through local recycling markets. (iv) Period of Performance: The base period of performance will be from 01 April 2027 to 31 March 2032. This includes a 1-month phase-in period from 01 April 2027 to 30 April 2027, followed by four (4) one-year option periods beginning each 01 April thereafter. Place of Performance: Fort Stewart (FS) and Hunter Army Airfield (HAAF), Georgia. F.O.B. title: Finland – Vans – Pakettiautojen puitejärjestely
description: Tampereen Infra Oy kilpailuttaa puitejärjestelyn, jonka puitteissa voidaan hankkia noin 50 kpl Pohjoismaisiin olosuhteisiin ympärivuotisesti soveltuvaa pakettiautoa. Hankintaan sisältyvät polttomoottori- ja täyssähköpakettiautot. Polttomoottorikäyttöisiin luetaan myös hybridipakettiautot. Hankinta on jaettu kahteen osa-alueeseen: 1. Polttomoottoripakettiautot (sis. Hybridit) 2. Täyssähköpakettiautot Kyseessä on EU-kynnysarvon ylittävä tavarahankinta. Hankinnan ennakoitu kokonaisarvo on noin 2 500 000 € (alv 0 %). Hankintamenettelynä on hankintalain 32 § avoin menettely. Osatarjoukset ovat sallittuja eli tarjoaja voi tarjota ja tulla valituksi yhteen tai useampaan osa-alueeseen. Vaihtoehtoiset ja rinnakkaiset tarjoukset ovat kiellettyjä. Hankittavat ajoneuvot ovat lähtökohtaisesti aina uusia, mutta tilaaja voi erikseen sallia kevennetyissä kilpailutuksissa myös käytetyt ajoneuvot. Puitejärjestelyyn valitaan osa-aluekohtaisesti kaikki tarjoajat, jotka täyttävät soveltuvuusvaatimukset ja joiden tarjous täyttää hankinnan vähimmäisvaatimukset. Sopimuskaudella puitejärjestelyn sisäiset hankinnat tehdään kevennettyinä kilpailutuksina.

Hankinta suoritetaan kokonaisurakkana, joka sisältää entisten rakenteiden purkamisen, uuden polttonesteiden jakeluaseman suoja-alustan ml. viemäröinti ja ympäristönsuojausrakenteet, maankaivuu- ja maanrakennustyöt sekä polttonesteiden jakeluasemaan kuuluvat säiliöt, rakenteet ja laitteet sekä näihin kuuluvien rakenteiden ja laitteiden tarkentavat suunnittelu-, hankinta-, rakennus-, kokoonpano- ja asennustyöt ml. sähkösuunnittelu ja -työt. Hankintojen kohteiden tarkempi kuvaus on eritelty tarjouspyynnön liitteissä (urakan tekniset määrittelyt). Osa tarjouspyynnön liitteistä on turvaluokiteltuja asiakirjoja, jotka sisältävät urakkaan sisältyviä yksityiskohtaisia tietoja. Liitteet lähetetään suojattuna sähköpostina vain niille urakoitsijan edustajille, jotka ovat allekirjoittaneet Turvallisuussopimuksen liitteen 1.7 Vaitiolositoumuksen ja lähettäneet sen liitetiedostona 2.11.2026 klo 15:00 mennessä sähköpostilla osoitteeseen: kiinteisto.kehittaminen.rvle@raja.fi. Viestiin otsikko: "Vaitiolositoumus Karttimo". Vaitiolositoumusten tulee olla kaikilta osin täydennetty ja allekirjoitettu jokaisen tarjouspyyntöön osallistuvan osalta.,

title: Pumppaamot metrolinjalle -puitejärjestely
description: Helsingin kaupungin liikenneliikelaitos, Länsimetro Oy ja Sammalvuoren Metrovarikko Oy hankkivat pumppaamoita metrolinjoille tämän tarjouspyyntökokonaisuuden (tarjouspyyntö ja sen liitteet) mukaisesti. Hankintaan sisältyy perusvesipumppaamot ja myös muita pumpputyyppejä. Erilaiset pumppaamot ja pumput ovat hankinnan pääasiallinen kohde. Hankinta toteutetaan puitejärjestelynä kolmen Toimittajan kanssa. Pumppaamot metrolinjalle hankinta on jaettu kahteen (2) osa-alueeseen: - Osa-alue 1: Kantametro (HKL) - Osa-alue 2: Länsimetro ja Sammalvuoren Metrovarikko. Tarjoaja voi tarjota yhtä tai kahta osa-aluetta. Hankinnan ennakoitu kokonaisarvo kuuden (6) vuoden mukaan laskettuna on yhteensä noin 2,5 M€ euroa (alv 0%). Arviossa on otettu huomioon kaikki mukana olevat osa-alueet. Hankinnan kohde ja vaatimukset on kuvattu tarkemmin tämän tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevissa dokumenteissa., Osa-alue 1: Kantametro (HKL) Hankinta Pumppaamot metrolinjalle -puitejärjestelyn tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Osa-alueeseen 1 sisältyy Kantametron osuus (HKL)., Osa-alue 2: Länsimetro ja Sammalvuoren metrovarikko Hankinta Pumppaamot metrolinjalle -puitejärjestelyn tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Osa-alueeseen 2 sisältyy Länsimetron ja Sammalvuoren Metrovarikon osuus.,

title: Metsurihakkuu- ja puunkaatopalvelut 2027-2028
description: Metsurihakkuu- ja puunkaatopalvelut 2027-2028 Mikkelin kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön infra- ja viheraluepalvelut-yksikkö pyytää tarjouksia taajamien metsurihakkuu- ja puunkaatopalveluista. Hankinnan sopimuskausi on kaksi vuotta ajalla 1.1.2027-31.12.2028. Työkohteet sijaitsevat pääosin Mikkelin keskustaajamassa ja tarvittaessa kaupunkiin kuuluvissa taajamissa: Anttola, Ristiina, Otava ja Haukivuori. Hakkuu- ja raivaustyöt painottuvat tammi- huhtikuulle ja syys- joulukuulle, jolloin se pääsääntöisesti edellyttää arkipäivisin läsnäoloa työmaalla. Arvioitu tarjottava työmäärä on arviolta noin 1200 tuntia kalenterivuosittain. Annetun tuntihinnan tulee sisältää kaikki laskutettavat kustannukset. Siirroista, matka-ajalta, työvälineistä tai huolloista ym. ei makseta erillisiä korvauksia. Tuntihinta annetaan euroina / tunti, alv. 0 %. Hinta on kiinteä koko sopimuskauden ajan. Työtehtäviin kuuluu rakennus-, puisto- ja taajamametsäkohteiden hakkuu- ja raivaustöitä, myrskytuhopuiden korjuuta sekä yksittäisten tontti, katu- ja puistopuiden vaikeita kaatotöitä. Kiipeilykaatoa ei edellytetä, mutta huomioidaan tarjousten vertailussa annettavissa laatupisteissä. Työmaat ovat ajoittain laajoja ja vaativat palveluntuottajalta itsenäistä kykyä suunnitella töiden toteutusta mm. ajouraverkostot hakkuutyömailla. Suunnitelmat karttoineen annetaan aina työkohteittain kirjallisena. Palveluntuottajan tulee osata toteuttaa puutavaran apteeraus eri puutavaralajeiksi omatoimisesti, ja tilaajan niin määrätessä, tilaajan osoittamalla tavalla. Talvityömailla hakataan puutavaraa metsurityönä arviolta noin 400–600 m3. Hakkuu- ja raivaustyöt painottuvat tammi- huhtikuulle ja syys- joulukuulle. Touko- elokuun aikana pidetään lähtökohtaisesti taukoa. Kesätauon aikana sattuvien äkillisten ja odottamattomien myrskyjen tuhojen korjaamista on pystyttävä suorittamaan 24 tunnin varoitusajalla tilaajan pyynnöstä aiemmin mainittujen kohteiden alueella. Myrskytuhoja korjataan tilaajan ohjaamana yhdessä kaupungin vakituisen henkilöstön kanssa. Kesällä on mahdollisuus tehdä yksittäisiä vesakonniittokohteita keskustaajaman alueella. Vähimmäisvaatimuksen alittava myrskytuhojen raivauksen varoitusaika huomioidaan tarjousten vertailussa annettavissa laatupisteissä. Palveluntuottajalla tulee olla käytettävissään työssä tarvittava sekä tavanomainen että erikoiskalusto mm. kaadonsuuntaaja, vaijerillinen vetotalja ja työmaan varoitusmerkit. Mikäli tarjoaja tarjoaa kiipeilykaatoa, tulee tarjoajalla olla käytettävissään myös siihen tarvittava kalusto. Työmaa-alueilla ajoneuvoon vaaditaan huomiovilkut. Pohjavesialueella työskennellessä tulee olla valmius öljyntorjuntaan. Palveluntuottajalla tulee olla varamiesjärjestelmä, jotka koskevat samat vaatimukset kuin muuta henkilöstöä. Tarjoajan tulee antaa kirjallinen selvitys varamiesjärjestelmän toteutuksesta käytännössä. Palveluntuottajan tulee olla tietoinen PEFC sertifiointijärjestelmästä ja sen vaatimuksista suoritettavan työn suhteen, ja tarjoajan tulee olla ilmoittautunut mukaan PEFC-sertifiointiin. Palveluntuottajan tulee olla perehtynyt voimassa oleviin viranomaisten antamiin sekä työehtosopimuksissa oleviin työsuojelu- ja työturvallisuusmääräyksiin. Työssä noudatetaan edellä mainittuja määräyksiä ja käytetään niiden mukaisia suoja- ja turvavarusteita.,

dokumenty, w tym dokumenty potwierdzające umocowanie do reprezentowania, sporządzone w języku obcym przekazuje się wraz z
tłumaczeniem na język polski. Maksymalny rozmiar jednego pliku przesyłanego za pośrednictwem dedykowanych formularzy do:
złożenia, zmiany, wycofania oferty wynosi 150 MB natomiast przy komunikacji wielkość pliku to maksymalnie 500 MB. Zamawiający
rekomenduje wykorzystanie formatów: .pdf .doc .docx .xls .xlsx .jpg (.jpeg) ze szczególnym wskazaniem na .pdf Zamawiający
dopuszcza także format RAR. Pliki w innych formatach niż PDF zaleca się opatrzyć zewnętrznym podpisem XAdES. Wykonawca
powinien pamiętać, aby plik z podpisem przekazywać łącznie z dokumentem podpisywanym. Sposób sporządzenia dokumentów
elektronicznych, oświadczeń lub elektronicz

title: Germany – Coaching services – Rahmenvereinbarung Beratungsformate Coaching, Training und Mediation
description: Die Gebäudemanagement Schleswig-Holstein (GMSH) AöR ist Dienstleister für das Land Schleswig-Holstein, für die Bundesrepublik Deutschland und für sonstige Träger der öffentlichen Verwaltung. In der Rechtsform einer Anstalt des öffentlichen Rechts bilanziert die GMSH nach Handelsrecht. Ihre Hauptaufgaben sind die Projektierung und Durchführung von Bauvorhaben für Land, Bund und andere Träger der öffentlichen Verwaltung, die Bewirtschaftung der Liegenschaften des Landes Schleswig-Holstein und die zentrale Beschaffung für die Dienststellen des Landes Schleswig-Holstein. Die GMSH hat zurzeit ca. 1.800 Beschäftigte. Für die GMSH bildet eine Unternehmenskultur, in der das Miteinander arbeiten auf Augenhöhe ein Selbstverständnis darstellt, die Basis für eine erfolgreiche Erledigung ihrer Aufgaben und der steten Verbesserung darin. Dazu bietet die Personalentwicklung in der GMSH ein umfangreiches Portfolio an Programmen und Instrumenten an, wie beispielsweise die Führungsakademie, Führungs-Onboarding und spezifische Angebote für fachliche Zielgruppen. Entsprechend eines systemischen Verständnisses stärken wir in all unseren Angeboten Persönlichkeit, Individualität und Selbstreflexion. Neben den Qualifizierungsprogrammen für verschiedene Gruppen gehören zu unserem Portfolio auch zahlreiche Beratungsangebote und individuelle Formate. Die Selbstmanagementfähigkeiten der Beschäftigten sollen stets gefördert werden, insbesondere im Kontext von Agilität, Unsicherheiten und Veränderung. Mit dieser Ausschreibung suchen wir Partner/-innen, die uns bei der Qualifizierung und individuellen Weiterentwicklung unterstützen. Die Ausschreibung erfolgt für folgende Leistungsgegenstände: • A Coaching • B Training • C Mediation Die GMSH sieht für die jeweiligen Leistungsgegenstände Pools vor, um anliegenspezifisch die Beschäftigten mit den Coaches/Trainierenden/Mediator/-innen zusammenbringen zu können. An-gebote für ein oder mehrere Leistungsgegenstände sind möglich. Wir bitten alle Bieter/-innen sich in jedem Leistungsgegenstand zu bewerben, in dem sie tätig werden möchten. Für den Rahmenvertrag gelten folgende Höchstwerte in Bezug auf die benötigten Leistungen: Los 1 (Coaching): 468.000 € netto bezogen auf die maximale Laufzeit der Rahmenvereinbarung (4 Jahre). Los 2 (Training): 754.000 € netto bezogen auf die maximale Laufzeit der Rahmenvereinbarung (4 Jahre). Los 3 (Mediation): 176.000 € netto bezogen auf die maximale Laufzeit der Rahmenvereinbarung (4 Jahre). Der Auftraggeber ruft die Stunden/Aufträge jeweils nach Bedarf ab. Es besteht kein Anspruch des Auftragnehmers auf Leistungsabruf in einem bestimmten Umfang. Eine Aufnahme in den Pool je Los erfolgt, wenn mindestens 65 Punkte in der Gesamtwertung gem. Bewertungsmatrix erreicht werden. Eine Begrenzung, mit wie vielen Anbietern ein Vertrag pro Los geschlossen wird, erfolgt nicht. Zur Angebotsabgabe (Phase 2) werden diejenigen Bewerber aufgefordert, die alle formalen Anforderungen erfüllen und kein Ausschlussgrund vorliegt. Es gibt keine Begrenzung, wie viele Bewerber zur Angebotsabgabe je Los aufgefordert werden. Die Verhandlungsgespräche finden voraussichtlich in der 4./5./6. Kalenderwoche 2027 statt.

title: Finland – Research, testing and scientific technical simulator – Laboratory-scale biogas reactors for the Natural Resources Institute Finland
description: Natural Resources Institute Finland (Luke) is requesting offers from suppliers for the procurement of laboratory scale biogas reactors. The procurement target is laboratory-scale continuously stirred tank reactors (CSTRs) for research purposes. Reactors must be suitable for studying process performance, especially the methane production and digestate quality, of anaerobic digestion of various types of biomass: slurries, sludges, manures, and also drier materials (plant biomass, food waste, etc.) as a co-feedstock. Equipment is needed for semi-continuous operation with manual feeding and digestate removal possible without opening the reactor or interrupting the process. Reactors must be equipped with adjustable stirring and temperature control; the heating mechanism must ensure a stable temperature. The requirement is for four (4) CSTR units.

title: I/64 Hazlov – měření hluku
description: Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je provedení posouzení hlukové zátěže v lokalitě přiléhající k silnici I/64, v níž se nachází obytná zástavba a veřejně přístupné sportoviště obce. Dotčené území není v současné době vybaveno žádnými protihlukovými opatřeními. Součástí plnění bude zjištění a vyhodnocení skutečné úrovně hluku z provozu na silnici I/64 v souladu s platnými právními předpisy a technickými normami. V případě prokázání překročení hygienických limitů hluku bude zpracován návrh vhodných protihlukových opatření vedoucích ke snížení hlukové zátěže v dotčeném území. Odůvodnění veřejné zakázky: Potřeba realizace veřejné zakázky vychází z existence obytné zástavby a veřejně přístupného sportoviště v bezprostřední blízkosti silnice I/64, které nejsou chráněny žádnými protihlukovými opatřeními. Vzhledem k intenzitě silničního provozu existuje důvodný předpoklad zvýšené hlukové zátěže v dané lokalitě. Cílem zakázky je objektivně zjistit skutečný stav hlukové zátěže a ověřit splnění hygienických limitů stanovených platnou legislativou. Výstupy zakázky budou sloužit jako podklad pro rozhodnutí o případné realizaci vhodných protihlukových opatření a pro zajištění ochrany obyvatel a uživatelů veřejného prostoru před nadměrným hlukem.

title: B 209 Elbquerung bei Lauenburg, Floristische - Faunistische Erhebungen 2027
description: Der Landesbetrieb Straßenbau und Verkehr Schleswig-Holstein, Standort Lübeck und der Niedersächsische Landesbetrieb für Straßenbau und Verkehr, regionaler Geschäftsbereich Lüneburg planen gemeinsam in Auftragsverwaltung des Straßenbaulastträgers Bund den Ersatzbau der B 209 Elbquerung bei Lauenburg/Hohnstorf mit Neubau der Ortsumgehung Lauenburg Ost. Das Vorhaben ist ein Teilprojekt der Planung „B 5 / B 209 Elbquerung bei Lauenburg/Hohnstorf mit Ortsumgehungen“. Die Festlegung der Vorzugsvariante für die Elbquerung durch den Baulastträger steht zum jetzigen Zeitpunkt noch aus. In der abschließenden Wahl stehen die beiden bestandsnahen Brückenvarianten BBW-1-0-BR („Bestand-West“) und BBO-1-4-BR („Bestand-Ost“). Je nach Variante beträgt die Länge der Strecke zwischen den Anknüpfungspunkten ca. 2,6 bis 2,7 km. Bestand-West beinhaltet 2 Brücken, eine über die Elbe und eine über die Bahnlinie östlich des Bahnhofs Lauenburg. Bestand-Ost beinhaltet eine lange Brücke über die Elbe und über Teile des anschließenden binnendeichs gelegenen Lauenburger Elbwarders. Weiter östlich verlaufen beide Varianten gemeinsam auf ehemaligen Industriegleisen entlang des Gewerbegebiets Lauenburg-Ost sowie entlang der vorhandenen Gewerbegebietsanbindung an die B 5. Die Straße wird als zweispurige außerörtliche Bundesstraße mit Regelquerschnitt RQ 11 und begleitendem Radweg geplant. Gegenstand der Leistung ist das Erbringen von floristisch-faunistischen Leistungen für einen Bereich von 500 m um die beiden Varianten des Bauvorhabens (ca. 400 ha) als Grundlage weiterer landschaftsplanerischer Fachbeiträge wie dem Landschaftspflegerischen Begleitplan (LBP), dem Artenschutzbeitrag (ASB) und der FFH-Verträglichkeitsprüfung (FFH-VP) auf den Ebenen der Entwurfsplanung und der Genehmigungsplanung.

title: Medizinische Betreuung in der Erstaufnahmeeinrichtung Neumünster
description: Das LaZuF betreibt dazu in 24539 Neumünster, Haart 148 eine Landesunterkunft (LUK) und Erstaufnahmeeinrichtung mit einer Kapazität von bis zu 1.120 Betten für die Bewohnenden. Perspektivisch ist eine Erhöhung der Kapazität auf 1.250 Betten vorgesehen. In besonderen Ausnahmesituationen kann die Belegung vorübergehend auch über diesem Wert liegen. Dabei handelt es sich jedoch um zeitlich begrenzte Ausnahmefälle. Weitere Standorte in Schleswig-Holstein sind vorhanden, jedoch nicht Angebotsbestandteil. Das LaZuF wird als zuständige Zuwanderungsbehörde und Vertragspartner vor Ort mit Personal vertreten sein. Die Bewohnenden werden von einem Betreuungsdienstleister beraten und betreut. Ihre Verpflegung wird über ein Catering sichergestellt. Der Wachdienst ist 24 / 7 vor Ort. Eine Polizeistation ist auf dem Gelände montags bis freitags tagsüber besetzt. Bei der Gestaltung der Unterbringung, Beratung, Betreuung und Verpflegung ist von allen die besondere Schutzbedürftigkeit von Kindern, Frauen, Jugendlichen, LSBTI*-Schutz-suchenden, Menschen mit Behinderungen, religiöse Minderheiten, Personen mit schweren körperlichen Erkrankungen oder psychischen Störungen, älteren Menschen, Schwangeren, Alleinerziehenden mit minderjährigen Kindern, Opfern geschlechts-spezifischer Gewalt, weiblicher Genitalverstümmelung, Zwangsheirat oder Menschenhandel und Opfern von Gewalt aufgrund sexueller, geschlechtsbezogener, rassistischer oder religiöser Motive zu berücksichtigen. Geeignete Maßnahmen zur angemessenen Versorgung sind erforderlich. Die Versorgung großer Zahlen von Geflüchteten, die in einem ungewohnten Umfeld leben müssen und nicht über eigene finanzielle Mittel verfügen, stellt hohe Anforderungen an die Aufgabenerfüllung des Leistungserbringers. Der Auftraggeber erwartet daher eine besonders zuverlässige und hochflexible Leistungserbringung von einem Leistungserbringer mit Erfahrungen in diesem Bereich. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Der Höchstwert dieser Rahmenvereinbarung liegt bei 15.000.000,00 € für den ausgeschriebenen Zeitraum inkl. title: Espoon kaupungin sekä kaupunkikonserniin kuuluvien tytäryhteisöjen ja säätiöiden tilintarkastuspalveluiden hankinta 2027
description: Espoon kaupungin sekä kaupunkikonserniin kuuluvien tytäryhteisöjen ja säätiöiden tilintarkastuspalveluiden hankinta 2027 Espoon kaupunki (myöhemmin myös Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia Espoon kaupungin sekä kaupunkikonserniin kuuluvien tytäryhteisöjen ja säätiöiden sekä yhdistyksen tilintarkastuspalveluista tilivuosille 2027-2029 sekä optiona vuosille 2030-2032. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on tarjouspyynnön liitteellä 1. "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Hankinnan valmistelu Hankintayksikkö on valmistellut hankintaa arvioimalla markkinoilla olevia vaihtoehtoja ja kilpailuolosuhteita sekä hankinnan toteuttamistapoja. Markkinakartoitusilmoitus on julkaistu HILMA:ssa 30.4.2026. Markkinakartoituksessa on kuultu alan toimijoita markkinavuoropuhelun kautta sekä hyödynnetty asiantuntijanäkemyksiä, arvioitu hankinnan jakamista osiin sekä eri toteutusmalleja. Markkinakartoitus on toteutettu siten, ettei yksittäistä toimittajaa ole suosittu ja kartoituksessa on toimittu tasapuolisesti ja avoimesti. Markkinakartoitusilmoituksessa ei rajattu markkinavuoropuheluun kutsuttavien potentiaalisten tarjoajien määrää. Kartoituksen keskeiset havainnot ovat, että alalla on rajallinen määrä toimijoita, jotka kykenevät toteuttamaan tarjouspyynnön mukaisen hankinnan vaaditussa laajuudessa. Hankinnan toteutus, jossa sekä Espoon kaupungin lakisääteiset tilintarkastuspalvelut että konserniyhteisöjen tilintarkastus toteutetaan saman Toimittajan toimesta rajaa potentiaalisten tarjoajien määrää suhteessa näiden toteuttamiseen erillisinä osa-alueina. Kartoituksessa saatuja havaintoja on hyödynnetty hankinnan kohteen ja soveltuvuusvaatimusten-, tarjousten vertailuperusteiden - sekä sopimusehtojen määrittelyssä. Hankintayksikkö katsoo, että hankinnan valmistelu täyttää hankintalain 65 §:n vaatimukset ja tukee kilpailun toteutumista. Hankinnan jakaminen osiin Hankintayksikkö on arvioinut hankinnan jakamista osiin. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska sen toteuttaminen yhtenä kokonaisuutena on kustannustehokkain ja tarkoituksenmukaisin vaihtoehto huomioiden kaupunkikonsernin toimintaympäristön. Lisäksi kuntalain 122 §:n mukaan kunnan tytäryhteisön tilintarkastajaksi on lähtökohtaisesti valittava kunnan tilintarkastusyhteisö, ellei poikkeamiseen ole perusteltua tarkastuksen järjestämiseen liittyvää syytä. Hankintayksikön selvityksen perusteella poikkeamiselle ei ole perusteltua syytä. Hankinnan jakaminen osiin lisäisi lisäksi sopimuskauden hallinnollista taakkaa sekä vaikeuttaisi sopimusseurantaa ja palvelun koordinointia. Edellä mainituin perustein hankintayksikkö katsoo, että hankinnan jakamatta jättäminen on hankinnan luonne, tavoitteet ja toteutustapa huomioon ottaen perusteltua.,

title: Lukko- ja oviautomatiikkatarvikkeet ja palvelut OYS
description: Lukko- ja oviautomatiikkatarvikkeet ja palvelut OYS Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue Pohde pyytää tarjoustanne Lukko- ja oviautomatiikkatuotteista ja niihin liittyvistä palveluista. Hankinnan kohteena ovat lukituspalvelut Oulun Yliopistolliseen sairaalaan ja Peltolan kampukselle (Peltolan psykiatrian yksiköt sekä Konsti kehitysvammahuolto). Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska OYS:n ja Peltolan yksiköiden lukkopalvelut muodostavat toiminnallisesti, teknisesti ja turvallisuuden näkökulmasta yhtenäisen kokonaisuuden. Kohteiden lukitusjärjestelmät sekä ylläpito ja vikapalvelut edellyttävät keskitettyä kokonaisvastuuta. Hankinnan jakaminen usealle toimittajalle lisäisi rajapintoja, vastuunjakoa ja turvallisuusriskejä sekä vaikeuttaisi häiriötilanteiden hallintaa ja palvelun jatkuvuuden varmistamista. Lisäksi useamman toimittajan käyttö kasvattaisi hankintayksikön hallinnollista työtä ja voisi johtaa päällekkäisiin kustannuksiin. Tämän vuoksi hankinnan toteuttaminen yhtenä kokonaisuutena on palvelun laadun, turvallisuuden, toimintavarmuuden ja kokonaistaloudellisuuden kannalta perusteltua. Talvikunnossapitoon kuuluu katujen, kevyenliikenteen väylien, yleisten alueiden ja kaupungin kiinteistöjen lumen auraus, polanteen poisto sekä liukkaudentorjunta. Tarjottavat talvikunnossapitokohteet on jaettu osahankintoihin liitteenä olevan karttamateriaalin mukaisesti. Talvikunnossapidon osa-alueita on yhteensä kuusi (6) kpl. Osa-alueiden järjestys/nimeäminen poikkeaa numerojärjestyksestä hankintayksikön parhaaksi katsoman merkintätavan vuoksi. Tarjoaja voi antaa tarjouksen yhteen tai useampaan osa-alueeseen. Osatarjoukset osa-alueilla eivät ole mahdollisia, eli tarjoajan tulee tarjota molempia (aurausta ja liukkauden torjuntaa) tarjoamalleen osa-alueelle. Tarjoaja voi tarjota samaa kalustoa ja henkilöstöä useammalle osa-alueelle. Mikäli tarjoaja ilmoittaa käyttävänsä useampaa kalustoa kuin vähimmäisvaatimuksissa on edellytetty, tulee tarjouspyynnössä asetetun palvelutason täyttyä kaikkien ilmoitettujen kalustojen osalta. Kaikkien tarjouslomakkeella ilmoitettujen kalustojen on kyettävä lähtemään toimeksiannon saatuaan omille vastuualueilleen viimeistään yhden (1) tunnin kuluessa toimeksiannosta. Tarjoajan kaluston riittävyys arvioidaan kaikkien tarjottujen osa-alueiden osalta samanaikaisesti. Hankintayksikkö voi kohdentaa tarjoajan kaluston ensisijaisesti tietyille osa-alueille. Tarkemmat hankinnan vertailuperusteet ovat tarjouspyynnön kohdassa "päätöksenteon perusteet". Mikäli urakan toteuttamisessa käytetään useampaa työkonetta, tulee kaikkien urakassa käytettävien työkoneiden tuntiveloituksen olla sama kuin tarjouksessa ilmoitettu tuntihinta. Erillisiä konekohtaisia tai kalustotyypeittäin poikkeavia tuntihintoja ei hyväksytä. Mikäli urakan toteuttamisessa käytetään useampaa työkonetta, ei useamman koneen käyttö muuta vertailtavaa tuntihintaa. buyer: Oslo kommune v/ Boligbygg Oslo KF
title: Totalentreprise for installasjon av automatisk slukkeanlegg i Schwensens gate 9
description: Kontrakten omfatter prosjektering og installasjon av heldekkende automatisk slokkeanlegg i Schwensens gate 9. Prosjektet skal gjennomføres som totalentreprise i henhold til NS 8407:2011 og omfatter komplett levering av slokkeanlegg med nødvendige tekniske og bygningsmessige arbeider. Dette inkluderer blant annet etablering av teknisk rom, nødvendige arbeider knyttet til vannforsyning, elektro- og brannalarmanlegg, branntekniske tiltak, samt hulltaking, branntetting og øvrige hjelpearbeider som er nødvendige for en komplett og funksjonell leveranse. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å øke brannsikkerheten for beboerne og sikre bygget med et automatisk slokkeanlegg som tilfredsstiller gjeldende krav og forutsetninger. Tiltaket inngår i Boligbygg Oslo KFs langsiktige arbeid med å oppgradere brannsikkerheten i den kommunale boligmassen og redusere risikoen for tap av liv og materielle verdier ved brann.

buyer: Oslo kommune v/ Boligbygg Oslo KF
title: Rehabilitering av Christian Michelsens gate 57-61
description: Prosjektet omfatter rehabiliteringsarbeider av Christian Michelsens gate 57-61 for Boligbygg Oslo KF, og skal gjennomføres som en totalentreprise etter NS 8407. Tiltaket gjelder i hovedsak utskifting av vinduer og balkongdører, taknedløp, eksisterende radiatoranlegg med tilhørende rørføringer, oppussing av trapperom, lokale fasade- og betongreparasjoner, samt etterisolering av loft. Det inngår også nødvendige rive-, sanerings- og følgearbeider. Prosjektet innebærer dessuten forhold knyttet til asbest, beboerhåndtering og arbeider i hovedrømningsvei. Byggene er oppført i 1936 og består av fire boligetasjer, loft og underetasje/kjeller. Eiendommen omfatter totalt 10 oppganger fordelt på adressene 57 a-d, 59 a-c og 61 a-c. Byggene har teglfasader, delvis pussede partier ved trapperom og fasadesokkel av naturstein. Alle byggene står på Byantikvarens gule liste og inngår i Verneplan for Boligbygg. Dette innebærer at løsninger som påvirker fasade og tak skal ivareta antikvariske hensyn og godkjennes av byggherre og vernemyndighet. Formålet med prosjektet oppsummeres til: * Økt energieffektivitet (nye vinduer og etterisolere loft) * Fornyet teknisk infrastruktur (varme og ventilasjon) * Bedre bokvalitet og visuell oppgradering (rehabilitering av fasade og fellesarealer)

title: Bergsikring av Oddahallen
description: Oddahallen er eit fjellanlegg etablert i fjellet på austsida av friidrettsanlegget i Odda med overdekning opp mot bustadfeltet på Fureskorane. Oddahallen er ein sentral arena spesielt for barn og unge innan idrett, skule og fritidsaktivitetar i kommunen. Den har og ein kritisk funksjon i samanheng med beredskap som det største tilfluktsrommet i kommunen. Det er gjennomført ei ny ingeniørgeologisk kartlegging etter registrert nedfall i idrettshallen. Tidlegare rapportar frå Norconsult (2021 og 2022) har tilrådd oppfølging og kartlegging av bergmasse og sikringstiltak. Den siste tida har delar av anlegget vore stengt i påvente av ei grundig tilstandsvurdering og naudsynte sikringstiltak. Befaring og kartlegging utført av Norconsult syner at eksisterande bergsikring over betongkvelvet og ved skytebanen i Oddahallen er sterkt korrodert og har mista funksjonen sin. Det er naudsynt å gjennomføre bergsikring med nye bergband, heilstøypte boltar, steinsprangnett og utbetring av plankesperrer før hallen kan gjenopnast. Det er kritisk for Ullensvang kommune å få gjenopna hallen igjen, og konkurransen blir difor gjennomført med korte fristar. Befaring er planlagt 06.11 kl. 12.00. Oppmøte ved Oddahallen.
